title: Terminator Task Chain
description: A multi-step workflow that executes sequentially, passing context between steps

description.description: Human-readable description of what this chain does

action.description: The action to perform (e.g. check_email, research, notify)

skill.description: Which skill to use for this step

tool.description: Specific MCP tool to invoke (alternative to skill)

tool_args.description: Arguments for the tool (when using tool instead of skill)

prompt.description: Custom prompt for this step (overrides default action prompt)

on_failure.description: What to do if this step fails

condition.description: Optional condition to evaluate before running this step

schedule.description: Optional cron expression to run this chain on a schedule

notify_on_complete.description: Send a notification when the chain finishes
